cargo-table.name: Cargo Table
cargo-table.role: Onboarding, first profit, first meaningful read

hiddenInfo.rule: The first aggressive action of each hand costs 10 less for the acting player.
hiddenInfo.reward: Positive results can yield low or mid-tier valuables. First clears strongly bias toward the Ivory Chip.

ledger-cellar.name: Ledger Cellar
ledger-cellar.role: Mid-stakes pressure room with quieter opponents and tighter reads

hiddenInfo.rule: The room is quieter, but every table tool use raises 1 extra heat. Soft reads matter more than brute pressure.
hiddenInfo.reward: Positive results tend to pay out layered valuables that bridge the run into Mirror Hall.

mirror-hall.name: Mirror Hall
mirror-hall.role: Main risk-reward table for the slice

hiddenInfo.rule: You may bring at most one valuable as collateral. Winning the final hand with collateral unlocks the best reward.
hiddenInfo.reward: Positive results grant high-tier valuables. The collateral line can pay out the Antique Commemorative Coin.

embers-table.name: Embers Table
embers-table.role: Late-run high stakes room where collateral and exposed goods both matter

hiddenInfo.rule: Luxury collateral is live here. If you close the room in profit, the room cools 1 heat before extraction math.
hiddenInfo.reward: The final room pays the heaviest luxury pieces, but it punishes weak exits harder than the others.

dock-braggart.name: Dock Braggart
dock-braggart.intro: Too loud for the cards he is actually holding.

ledger-clerk.name: Ledger Clerk
ledger-clerk.intro: Counts the room twice before he risks one chip.

calm-widow.name: Calm Widow
calm-widow.intro: Patient, precise, and excellent at noticing repetition.

smiling-knife.name: Smiling Knife
smiling-knife.intro: Coasts early, then leans on the table when the pot matters.

river-shark.name: River Shark
river-shark.intro: Looks passive until the pot starts smelling like a sure thing.

velvet-rook.name: Velvet Rook
velvet-rook.intro: Protects small edges and only turns sharp once the room gets narrow.

house-viper.name: House Viper
house-viper.intro: Never looks rushed, but the room tightens when he finally presses.

ash-smuggler.name: Ash Smuggler
ash-smuggler.intro: Hides under smoke and only shows teeth when the line looks soft.

smoky-den.name: Smoky Den
smoky-den.atmosphere: A dimly lit den filled with smoke and the sound of chips clinking.

high-rise-suite.name: High-Rise Suite
high-rise-suite.atmosphere: A private suite above the city where money talks softly and pressure lingers.

rooftop-club.name: Rooftop Club
rooftop-club.atmosphere: A social rooftop game where style, risk, and noise blur together.

neon-poker-club.name: Neon Poker Club
neon-poker-club.atmosphere: A synthetic late-night club where reads feel digital and every move leaves a trace.

marked-lens.name: Marked Lens
marked-lens.description: Peek one unrevealed community card once per table.

signal-lighter.name: Signal Lighter
signal-lighter.description: Read one opponent's current hand pressure as weak, medium, or strong.

player-notes.name: Player Notes
player-notes.description: Reveal one opponent's playing style archetype.

steadying-drink.name: Steadying Drink
steadying-drink.description: Reduce heat by 1 in the search phase.

disposable-phone.name: Disposable Phone
disposable-phone.description: Reveal every hidden layer of one table or refresh the fixed route offer.

kitchen-pass.name: Kitchen Pass
kitchen-pass.description: Flash it upstairs to reveal the service stairs extraction line.

dock-passkey.name: Dock Passkey
dock-passkey.description: Signals a hidden river launch route that never appears on the public board.

false-bottom-wallet.name: False-Bottom Wallet
false-bottom-wallet.description: On run failure, preserve the first 80 cash.

sleeve-clip.name: Sleeve Clip
sleeve-clip.description: Replace one hole card before the first betting decision of a hand.

old-silver-lighter.name: Old Silver Lighter
old-silver-lighter.description: A low-tier trophy that still moves well in the back room.

ivory-chip.name: Ivory Chip
ivory-chip.description: The cargo floor's favorite marker. Modest value, sharp symbolism.

ruby-cufflink.name: Ruby Cufflink
ruby-cufflink.description: A neat mid-tier pawn piece that still feels painful to lose.

gold-cased-watch.name: Gold-Cased Watch
gold-cased-watch.description: A stable high-value carry with no special trigger attached.

sealed-bond.name: Sealed Bond
sealed-bond.description: A bulky paper prize that pays well if you can carry it out.

pearl-necklace.name: Pearl Necklace
pearl-necklace.description: A graceful luxury piece that pawns cleanly in the right room.

emerald-brooch.name: Emerald Brooch
emerald-brooch.description: A rich green piece that holds its nerve as collateral.

obsidian-idol.name: Obsidian Idol
obsidian-idol.description: Heavy, awkward, and worth real money if you can still walk with it.

vault-promissory.name: Vault Promissory
vault-promissory.description: A private-room paper that lenders will honor if the room believes you survived.

fixedRoutes.name: Kitchen Backlift
fixedRoutes.flavor: A flour-dusted runner opens the service gate for one clean exit.

fixedRoutes.name: Linen Cart
fixedRoutes.flavor: You leave under folded cloth, if the hallway still belongs to the staff.

service-stairs.name: Service Stairs
service-stairs.flavor: A kitchen runner holds the stairwell open long enough for a clean exit if you move quickly.

river-launch.name: River Launch
river-launch.flavor: A silent launch waits below the loading docks, but only for someone already holding the right key.

fixedRoutes.name: VIP Elevator
fixedRoutes.flavor: A concierge keeps the service elevator unlocked for one exact descent.

fixedRoutes.name: Laundry Trolley
fixedRoutes.flavor: You disappear with pressed linens and a bored porter who never asks names.

service-stairs.name: Service Elevator
service-stairs.flavor: The maintenance shaft only stays open if the kitchen stamp is real.

river-launch.name: Basement Garage
river-launch.flavor: A quiet car waits under the tower, but only for someone carrying the right coded key.

fixedRoutes.name: Staff Door
fixedRoutes.flavor: A bartender palms you a staff badge and points to the back stairs.

fixedRoutes.name: Valet Loop
fixedRoutes.flavor: The valet stand folds you into the traffic before the rooftop buzz catches up.

service-stairs.name: Emergency Exit
service-stairs.flavor: A fire stair hidden behind the bottle wall opens only if the stamped pass checks out.

river-launch.name: Helipad Drop
river-launch.flavor: A charter pilot takes you off the roof if the access chip still reads green.

fixedRoutes.name: Data Node Gate
fixedRoutes.flavor: A coded maintenance gate blinks open for one clean exit window.

fixedRoutes.name: Hack Door
fixedRoutes.flavor: A spoofed employee route gives you twenty seconds before the club catches up.

service-stairs.name: Neural Jammer Corridor
service-stairs.flavor: A dead sensor lane appears only when the right utility token trips the jammer.

river-launch.name: Quantum Portal
river-launch.flavor: The back-end portal only resolves for runners carrying a synced dock key.
